description:
最新的2.0版本，但是以网页的形式
2.0修复了音频响应（除网页版）
新增了交互锁
新增了设置面板
新增了背景音乐
优化了模型部分的变形及阴影效果
优化了全局拖动的交互逻辑
优化了眼睛的闭合位置

无操作20分钟进入睡觉改为10分钟后进入睡觉
2分钟后自动惊醒改为5分钟后自动惊醒

1.每次启用时手动全屏优化为自动全屏
2.此网页壁纸分辨率从1k分辨率提升至4k分辨率
最新更新：
1.修复了网页版音频响应的问题
2.修复了网页版背景音乐无法正常播放的问题
3.优化了背景纹理质量
4.新增了设置面板的唤出方式（鼠标在桌面左键划出上上下下左右左右即可唤出）
5.背景音乐默认音量为0%可在设置面板中调整音量，音频响应灵敏度及平滑度可根据个人喜好调节
6.感谢 @顾人依旧 的修复技术支持

title: Space Journey
description:
[h1] "Welcome back, captain. Enjoy your ride." [/h1]

[h2] Overview [/h2]
Relax inside your spaceship while you travel through outer space. Enjoy the beauty of space or check up your vehicle inside a hangar. Turn on some fitting sci-fi music or listen for hostile communcations with your radio. Customize the colors of your spaceship to your liking to show who you really are.
The possibilities, just as space itself, [i]are endless[/i].

[h2] Features [/h2]
[list]
[*] Interactive wallpaper: left screen (navigation hud, shields, engine), right screen (navigation map), lower left screen (radio), lower right screen (music), joystick / cloche and joystick / cloche display are all interactive and clickable to either toggle features, change background or modify effects. These changes are temporary.
[*] Customizable wallpaper: tweak the wallpaper settings to your liking to customize your experience.
[*] Audio responsive lights.
[*] Customizable colors for background, hud, screens, shields, windshields and lights.
[*] Customizable frequencies for the best audio response.
[*] Parallax: because parallax effects are [i]cool[/i].
[/list]
